title: Dynatrace expands collaboration with Google Cloud to bring AI observability into Gemini Enterprise agent workflows
summary: Dynatrace brings AI observability to Gemini Enterprise agent workflows, so teams can run AI on Google Cloud with confidence.
body_markdown:
AI pilots can be easy. Operating AI in production is more complicated and comes with heightened risks.


As organizations deploy applications, AI agents, and automated workflows enabled by Google’s Gemini models at scale, they need visibility into how those systems behave, why they fail, what they cost, and how they affect customer experiences. That’s why Dynatrace is expanding its relationship with Google Cloud. Building on years of collaboration on cloud observability, this new phase of collaboration brings Dynatrace observability, automation, and AI intelligence into Gemini Enterprise agent workflows and Google Cloud AI environments, helping teams trace activity across models, agents, applications, and infrastructure from a single platform.


The expanded collaboration includes deeper integration with Gemini Enterprise, enhanced AI observability for Google Cloud environments, expanded joint customer programs, and broader availability through Google Cloud Marketplace. Together, these capabilities give organizations the operational context they need to move AI services into production with confidence.


## What’s new


The expanded collaboration with Google Cloud focuses on three areas:


- **Dynatrace for Gemini Enterprise:** Dynatrace brings real-time observability data, Grail data, causal AI insights, and trustworthy automation into Gemini Enterprise workflows. Teams can investigate issues, identify root causes, understand business impact, and drive actions using natural language without switching between tools.
- **Expanded AI observability for Gemini-enabled environments:** Teams gain visibility across AI models, agents, applications, services, and infrastructure running on Google Cloud. They can trace AI activity, monitor latency and token consumption, manage costs, and connect technical performance to customer and business outcomes.
- **Broader customer access:** Expanded collaboration and Google Cloud Marketplace availability help customers adopt Dynatrace through their existing Google Cloud procurement and operating models.


> “Enterprises running AI in production face an operational challenge fundamentally different from anything that came before,” said Steve Tack, Chief Product Officer at Dynatrace. “The complexity it introduces, from tracing decisions across agent chains to connecting model behavior with application performance and business outcomes, requires a new kind of intelligence. Through our collaboration with Google Cloud, we’re giving customers exactly that: the observability and automation to run AI services reliably and act before customers are affected.”


## How does Dynatrace bring observability into Gemini Enterprise agent workflows?


A key focus of the expanded collaboration is helping organizations operationalize AI at scale.


Dynatrace for Gemini Enterprise brings real-time operational context into Gemini Enterprise agent workflows. Agents can access distributed traces, service relationships, topology information data, business events, Grail data, and root-cause insights when investigating issues across complex environments.


Teams can use natural language to investigate incidents and analyze system behavior. For example, an engineer can investigate a latency increase affecting an AI-enabled customer transaction and identify the models, agents, services, or infrastructure dependencies involved.


Dynatrace also connects causal problem analysis with business metrics. This helps teams understand not only where an issue began, but also how it affects users, transactions, revenue, or another defined business outcome. This context helps teams prioritize incidents based on impact rather than react to a flood of disconnected alerts.


Organizations can also combine Dynatrace’s causational problem analysis with business metrics. This helps teams understand not only where an issue began, but also how it affects users, transactions, revenue, or another defined business outcome. This context helps teams prioritize incidents based on impact rather than react to a flood of disconnected alerts.


The collaboration with Google Cloud also extends observability directly into developer workflows. Dynatrace provides observability data directly into Google Antigravity CLI, giving developers access to insights and root-cause analysis within the terminal, helping reduce context switching during troubleshooting and application development.


## How does Dynatrace observe Gemini-enabled AI applications?


As organizations build applications enabled by Google’s Gemini models and other AI services, they need visibility across the entire stack.


With Arize, a Dynatrace company, teams can trace AI applications and agents, evaluate their outputs, and investigate where and why they fail. Dynatrace complements this AI-native context with full-stack observability across the user experience, applications, services, and the infrastructure that powers them. Together, these capabilities connect how AI applications are built and improved with how they perform in production and the outcomes they deliver.


Teams can trace requests end to end, track token consumption and latency, and evaluate output quality. Powered by Grail, the Dynatrace Data Lakehouse, organizations can analyze AI telemetry alongside logs, metrics, traces, topology, and business context. Dynatrace Intelligence helps teams identify the root cause of issues faster by connecting model behavior with application performance, infrastructure health, and business outcomes.


Rather than forcing teams to correlate data across separate AI, application, and infrastructure tools, Arize and Dynatrace bring together AI-native evaluation with end-to-end observability across the broader production environment. This helps teams move faster while maintaining the governance, reliability, and operational control required for production AI workloads.


## AI observability in practice


The need for AI observability becomes clear when organizations move AI-powered services into production.


InPost, a leading logistics company,[uses Dynatrace and Google Cloud](https://www.dynatrace.com/customers/inpost-ai/) to support AI-driven operations across a rapidly growing delivery network. As InPost expands its use of AI for logistics forecasting, workforce planning, shopping agents, and software development, teams need visibility into how these systems perform, how they consume resources, and how they affect customer-facing services. Dynatrace provides operational insight across these environments, helping teams identify issues faster and maintain reliable digital experiences at scale.


> “Delivering a seamless digital experience requires visibility across an increasingly complex ecosystem of applications, services, and partners,” said Paweł Sawicki, Senior Engineering Director at InPost. “Dynatrace has helped us simplify operations, gain deeper insight into customer experiences, and proactively address issues before they impact end users. Combined with the innovation and scalability of Google Cloud, we can deliver reliable digital services while enabling our teams to focus on continuous innovation.”


[Vitality faces a similar challenge](https://www.dynatrace.com/customers/vitality-2/) as it expands AI-powered health and wellness experiences. As the company scales its use of Gemini models and Google Cloud offerings, Dynatrace provides visibility across the systems supporting those services. This helps Vitality understand application performance, identify issues more quickly, and maintain the reliability required to deliver more consistent AI-enabled experiences for members.


Whether organizations are using AI to optimize logistics operations, personalize customer experiences, or automate business processes, they need visibility across the entire AI delivery chain. By connecting model behavior, application performance, infrastructure health, and business outcomes in a single platform, Dynatrace helps teams operate AI services with greater reliability and confidence.


## Operate AI innovation with confidence


The expanded collaboration between Dynatrace and Google Cloud gives organizations the operational context to trace AI behavior, identify the source of performance issues, and connect technical performance to customer and business outcomes.


With Dynatrace observability, automation, and AI intelligence integrated across Gemini Enterprise and Google Cloud AI environments, teams can move AI services into production while maintaining the reliability and control those services require.


**Dynatrace is also extending observability into Google Antigravity workflows through the[Dynatrace plugin in Google’s Antigravity Plugin Marketplace](https://antigravity.google/blog/plugin-marketplace-in-antigravity/) .**


Dynatrace integrations for Gemini Enterprise are available through Google Cloud Marketplace:[Dynatrace for Gemini Enterprise](https://console.cloud.google.com/marketplace/product/dynatrace-marketplace-prod/dynatrace-for-gemini-enterprise)
